data.gender_notes: Kutti is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kutti is recorded with the meaning “Little One”. Kutti is a Hindu name meaning “Little One”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kutti expresses “Little One”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_marathi.name: Kutti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kutti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A term of endearment for a little girl, often used in Tamil culture to refer to a young girl
